description: Change an agent's mode: auto (on its own, following its strategy) or propose (the older ask-first mode, for an agent that still uses it). An agent with its own wallet has no watch mode: to halt it, use stop_agent. Open to some accounts only. Needs an access key that may act. Confirm with the person before choosing auto.
name: set_agent_mode
title: Change how much an agent may do alone
